headline.title: 用 Parseable 与 Datasette 分析 OpenTelemetry 追踪数据
headline.summary: Simon Willison 介绍如何把可观测性平台 Parseable 与 Datasette 结合，用于查看 OpenTelemetry 追踪数据。Parseable 提供 AGPL 开源 Rust 实现、企业版和云托管选项；Datasette 1.0a41 新增 OpenTelemetry 支持，可用于本地分析。
headline.title_en: Using Parseable with Datasette for OpenTelemetry traces
headline.summary_en: Simon Willison shares a TIL on combining Parseable, a new observability platform, with Datasette for OpenTelemetry traces. Parseable offers an AGPL-licensed Rust implementation in a single binary, plus enterprise and hosted options. Since Datasette 1.0a41 added OpenTelemetry support, this setup lets developers inspect and query trace data locally. The post is a practical guide for engineers evaluating lightweight observability and data exploration tools.
